title: Could you be loved - Bob Marley & The Wailers

lines.l: Could you be loved, and be loved
Or even try to school you
Love would never leave us alone
You must come out the light
Could you be loved, oh yeah, and be loved
The road of love is rocky, and you may stumble too
So while you point your fingers, someone else is judging you
Don't you be, don't you be loved?
Don't you be, don't you be, don't you be loved?
Don't you be, don't you be loved?
